required_manual_checks.description: State I1 with its evidence: the serving checkout lives at /Users/oscar/Desktop/ascendSite/ascend, inside iCloud Desktop sync, which creates `* N.*` duplicates; they faked a typecheck blocker (env_ascend_icloud_duplicate_files), forced 2A.3a-2's P4 exception (1,016 in .next), and reappeared in the fresh 2A.3a-2 build (867, found by ROLLOUT-2A3BC-2's preconditions), blocking a rollout until SERVE-CLEAN-001.

Every dependency on the current path, enumerated and evidenced: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.ascend.os.plist (ProgramArguments node_modules/.bin/next and WorkingDirectory both name the Desktop path; the plist is outside the repository); .env.production.local (mode 0600, moved or re-created, never copied into a synced location or printed); node_modules; the logs (~/Library/Logs, unaffected); scripts and docs that assume the serving tree's location (backup-production.sh reads .env.production.local from its own tree; deploy-smoke.mjs reads it from its app dir; repository docs that name the Desktop path); the Coordinator and agents' rule that the main checkout is the serving tree; worktrees under ~/AI/worktrees; and the git remote and branch state of the new checkout.

Recommend a target path outside every iCloud-synced folder (not ~/Desktop, ~/Documents or iCloud Drive), with the check that proves it is not synced, as an owner decision. The new serving checkout is a dedicated, detached checkout at the promoted pin used for serving only; development stays elsewhere.

A stopped-service sequence with pass and failure rows: prepare the new checkout at the pin outside iCloud with node_modules and the env file (0600), build there and verify zero duplicates while the old service still runs; bootout; Oscar edits the plist's two paths (a backup of the plist taken first); bootstrap; /login 200; the promoted deploy smoke with the current release passes; rollback restores the plist backup and bootstraps the old tree. Record what happens to the old Desktop checkout afterwards (kept for development, never serving).

List the documents and memories that must change once the move is executed (the serving-tree rule in agent instructions, the recovery runbook, any contract naming the Desktop path), so the execution task can carry them.
Contract only. No production contact, no plist edit, no move. The execution is a separate task drafted after this contract is promoted.

title: I1 permanent fix: contract for moving the production serving checkout out of iCloud sync (contract only; execution is a later task)
